messages:
Jules: deploy-bot flagged a 30% error-rate uptick on /v1/generate in the US-EAST canary slice. Not huge but steady for 6 mins. Thoughts on immediate action?

deploy-bot: Canary details: us-east-1, 3% traffic. Metric: generate.error_rate. Alert threshold: >20% for 5m. Action suggested: PAUSE rollout and notify oncall. :warning:

Nora: Is this likely a model or config change? We only changed a safety filter param and enabled a new routing rule for short prompts.

Ibrahim: Safety filter toggle could cause an increase if it misclassifies empty cases into a backend error. We should consider a silent fallback (route affected traffic to previous variant) rather than a full rollback to avoid blipping customer-facing logs.

Jules: I agree — prefer staged-fallback: move 100% of canary slice to previous model variant but keep automation off. Want to avoid triggering runbooks unless customer-facing SLOs break.

PlatformOps: Quick note: if we change routing for canary slice only, change window policy says we should post a short release note to #customers for enterprise users in the EMEA window. Any immediate customers to ping?

Emma: QA saw 2 reproductions of the error locally with the safety-filter on; stacktrace points to filter.apply() timing out. We should revert the toggle in the config first and monitor for 10m. Reverting config is less risky than model pin.

Nora: Good call. Can someone run the revert and then we decide if traffic pin needed?

Jules: I'm on it. Command: ```./releasectl config set --env canary --key safety.filter.enabled --value false --reason "canary error spike"```

deploy-bot: Change recorded: config toggle rollback requested by Jules. Estimated apply time 45s.

Jules: Toggle applied. Monitoring metrics.

Ibrahim: Metrics showing error_rate halved in 2 minutes. Still slightly above baseline but trending down.

Emma: Local reproduce no longer fails after revert. Looks like filter applied timeouts were the culprit.

PlatformOps: Since we reverted quickly and impact is low, propose a quiet fallback post: add a note to the release thread and only notify customers if error_rate remains >15% for 30m. Also file incident INC-7120 for RCA.

Nora: Agree with quiet path. I'll add a short blurb: "We observed transient elevated errors during a canary test of a safety filter parameter. We reverted the toggle and performance is returning to normal. No customer-facing outages detected."

Jules: Ops checklist: - config revert executed (Jules) - monitoring run for 30m (Ibrahim) - QA confirm (Emma) - incident created (PlatformOps) - release note draft (Nora). Anyone object to marking this as "quiet-fallback completed"?

Ibrahim: No objections. I'll keep the watch for the 30m window and escalate if it creeps back up.

deploy-bot: Monitor rule active: generate.error_rate for us-east-1, alert if >15% for 10m.

Emma: Can we add a test in the nightly canary suite to cover the safety.filter timing case? I can add a short-run test.

Nora: Please do. Also add a line to the postmortem about gating config changes with a brief performance test.

PlatformOps: Filing INC-7120 and assigning to Nora for the postmortem. Target: preliminary note in 3 hours.

Jules: Thanks all. Leaving automation off for the next 24h for this flag. Will re-enable after QA and RCA. Marking thread: resolved pending RCA. :white_check_mark:
